description: Every destination one code has ever pointed at, newest first, with the version number, the reason and when each became active. Use it to answer 'where did this code point last week?' or to recover a previous URL after a wrong retarget. The printed code itself never changed — only its target did.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID), as returned by qrtap_create_code, qrtap_create_codes_bulk or qrtap_list_codes. This is the internal id, not the short_url slug.

name: qrtap_code_history
